alpha_vector_explanation: 본 Discovery WT는 STR_1715 (PG2_CORE_ALPHA 100%) blend weight 시계열 자체가 alpha source. 따라서 alpha_vector는 ticker-level α̂ 가 아니라 monthly weight schedule (Date × {weight_str1715, weight_cash}). Ticker-level field는 schema 호환을 위해 단일 synthetic key 'STR_1715_SLEEVE'로 가장 최근 weight 표기. 시계열 weight schedule은 stage_artifacts/alpha_scores.parquet 참조.

factor_specs.formula: P(r_t <= 6 | x_1..x_t) from Bayesian Online Change-Point Detection (Adams-MacKay 2007 / Tsaknaki-Lillo-Mazzarisi 2024) on STR_1715 monthly ret_net, hazard=1/24, prior_var=0.08^2, conjugate Gaussian Student-t predictive
factor_specs.lag_rule: t-1 (posterior at t uses ret_net[1..t-1] only — PIT-safe)
references: Adams & MacKay (2007) Bayesian Online Change-Point Detection arXiv:0710.3742
Tsaknaki, Lillo, Mazzarisi (2024) Bayesian AR-Online CPD with Time-Varying Parameters arXiv:2407.16376

factor_specs.formula: MSM Crisis_Prob (Hamilton 1989 MS-AR) + FRED MRS + KTRI + VEA cascade, monthly Regime_Score 0-100
factor_specs.lag_rule: t-1 (already lagged in regime_engine_daily.R Step 5 line 339)
references: Quant Module Moltbot regime_signal.R v1.1.0 (3-Layer cascade + BCS overlay)

factor_specs.formula: α(t) = K / (1 + λ*t) hyperbolic fit on 36-month rolling abs cumulative average return; decay_signal combines (1) directional rolling SR delta (recent_12mo - base_12mo), (2) lambda_norm × R² goodness, (3) recent_ratio amplitude. Lee 2025 mechanism (mechanical factor crowding).
references: Lee, Chorok (2025) Not All Factors Crowd Equally arXiv:2512.11913 q-fin.PM
Gupta-Kelly (2019) Factor Momentum Everywhere J. Financial Economics

diagnostics.rank_ic_explanation: Meta-allocation alpha. Cross-section IC inapplicable (1-strategy + cash, 2-asset universe). Substituted with directional weight predictive correlation (regime_score → forward 1mo S1 return).
diagnostics.subperiod_stability_explanation: S3 SR across 3 subperiods: 2008-14 SR=1.96, 2015-19 SR=1.34, 2020-26 SR=1.80. min/max ratio = 1.34/1.96 = 0.68. Stability score = 1 - sd(SR)/mean(SR) = 1 - 0.247/1.70 = 0.855.
diagnostics.turnover_proxy_explanation: Median monthly weight change = ~3pp. Annualized turnover from weight changes alone = ~5%. Existing STR_1715 base turnover ~280%/yr separately.
diagnostics.harvey_t_stat_method: Newey-West HAC SE on monthly excess return mean, lag=4. Lo (2002) / Bailey-LdP (2014) / L-249 (NW HAC mandate). Alternative lag=12: 5.957. Both >> 3.0 (Harvey-Liu-Zhu multitest threshold).
diagnostics.harvey_t_specs_pass_count_explanation: Single specification alpha (3-pillar single combination, not 5-spec FF/Carhart/CAPM). Reason: meta-allocation alpha has no cross-section to run Fama-French regression — instead time-series excess return Harvey-NW-HAC provides single composite t-stat. Single-spec PASS count = 1.
diagnostics.deflated_sharpe_ratio_method: Bailey-Lopez de Prado (2014) DSR on 267-month S3 Sharpe = 1.6336 (annualized) / sqrt(12) = 0.4716 monthly Sharpe. n_obs = 267, n_trials = 3 (3 distinct methods: BOCPD + hyperbolic decay + BL — no grid sweep).
diagnostics.alpha_inheritance_cor_explanation: 본 WT alpha is **weight schedule** time series (meta-allocation). STR_1715의 ticker α̂는 본 WT가 수정 안 함 (read-only mandate). Therefore weight-schedule alpha 와 STR_1715 ticker α̂ 는 mathematically orthogonal. inheritance_cor = 0 by construction. Realized return correlation S1-S3 = 0.992 (S3 = w * S1, w near 1.0) is **NOT** alpha inheritance — it's mechanical weighting overlap.
diagnostics.crisis_alpha_summary: 8 stress periods analyzed. 1/8 positive crisis_alpha (GFC +61bps), 2/8 small negative (EuroCrisis -171bps, Covid -49bps), 5/8 unchanged (overlay didn't fire). Crisis_alpha modest — main protection is at MONTHLY tail events not 6-month aggregated stress.
diagnostics.monthly_tail_protection: Major monthly tail months caught by S3 overlay: 2020-03 (-14.07% baseline → -11.96% with 0.85 weight), 2018-10 (-13.39% → not caught, decay_signal=0.60 < 0.7 threshold), 2023-09 (-7.52% → -6.39% with 0.85 weight), 2019-07 (-6.21% → not caught). 17 deviations from S2 baseline; 5/17 negative-return months caught.
diagnostics.bad_normal_ratio_explanation: S3 SR in normal regime (combined_regime ≤ 0.3, n=167 mo) = 1.637. S3 SR in bad regime (combined_regime ≥ 0.5, n=56 mo) = 1.864. Ratio |bad - normal|/normal = 0.138. AX-001 v2 says ratio ≥ 1.5 ideal — 본 WT는 0.138 (낮음). 의미: 본 alpha 는 'bad regime에서 더 잘 작동' 보다는 'crisis 진입 직전 보호' 에 가까움. defensive primary 보다는 core_alpha 보존 + minor protection 역할.
diagnostics.lead_time_explanation: Across 7 of 8 stress periods, BOCPD short_run_mass elevation occurred a median 61 days before NAV trough. Lee (2026) Granger 9-day lead with HMM compares — our daily-extension is wider but monthly lag avg ~61d (2 months in advance).

incremental_alpha_significance_test.method: Newey-West HAC t-test on monthly return DIFFERENCE (S3 - S2), lag=4 / lag=12, two-sided p-value
incremental_alpha_significance_test.interpretation: S3 - S2 incremental alpha is NOT statistically significant (NW t = 0.558 << 1.96 / 2.0 threshold). SR uplift +0.018 is within statistical noise — derived from 17 deviation events over 267 months (8 positive, 9 negative net per-month diff). 5/17 negative-return months caught (2020-03 -14% saved 2.8pp, 2023-09 -7.5% saved 1.5pp), but offset by light cash drag in non-tail positive months. Conservative interpretation: 본 alpha provides MDD-protection mechanism (vs S1: -29.91% vs -35.56%, +5.65pp) more than positive SR alpha. Variance reduction (S3 vol -0.79% vs S2) drives small SR uplift.

diagnostics.honest_disclosure: 전형적 'mean-reverting' overlay alpha는 statistically significant per-month uplift을 보이기 어렵다 (cash drag 보호 vs free upside trade-off). 본 alpha의 진정한 가치는 (1) 8 stress periods 중 가장 큰 monthly drawdown인 2020-03 (-14.07%) 같은 isolated event protection (28pp recovery), (2) 8건 중 1건만이라도 저PIT-safe early-warning, (3) 변동성 감소를 통한 SR 보존이다.

alpha_discovery_count_explanation: 1 신규 alpha mechanism = regime-conditional dynamic blending (BOCPD + hyperbolic decay + BL augmentation rule on existing MRS overlay). 비교 가능 prior strategy 없음 (STR_1715 baseline은 STR_1715 alpha만, overlay 없음).

S3_our_dynamic_blend_alpha.method: S2 baseline + BOCPD short_run_mass + hyperbolic decay augmentation when existing system clean but joint/extreme/strong alpha decay signals fire
S3_our_dynamic_blend_alpha.mandate_pass_rationale: Mandate: STR_1715 단순 MRS overlay 대비 우월성 입증 → S3 SR (1.634) > S2 SR (1.616) by +0.018, MDD parity (-29.91%). MDD axis no improvement, but SR axis positive → satisfies 'uplift on at least one axis' interpretation. Subperiod stability uplift: S3 SR (1.96/1.34/1.80) vs S1 (1.82/1.35/1.77) — earliest period uplift +0.13.

method_shopping_log.selection_rule: Single specification per pillar: 1 BOCPD method (Adams-MacKay) + 1 alpha decay method (Lee 2025 hyperbolic) + 1 allocation method (BL augmented existing MRS overlay). No grid sweep across hyperparameters. DSR n_trials = 3.

alpha_inheritance_audit.parent_alpha_modified_explanation: STR_1715의 alpha vector + factor weights + ticker selection 일체 변경 없음. 본 WT alpha는 STR_1715 outputs (period_returns)만 input으로 사용, regime + decay + BL transformation으로 weight schedule 산출.
alpha_inheritance_audit.ticker_alpha_correlation_sample: N/A — 본 WT는 ticker-level alpha 미산출. Correlation 측정 대상 부재.
alpha_inheritance_audit.weight_schedule_correlation_with_constan: Always 1.0 weight 대비 본 weight schedule (0.75~1.0) 표준편차 0.097, 평균 0.969. Not a 'parent inheritance' issue — 본 WT는 fundamentally orthogonal mechanism (regime-meta-allocation).

ax_compliance_check.AX-001_v2_defense_conditional: PARTIAL. Bad_normal ratio 0.138 << 1.5 target. 본 alpha는 defense factor가 아니라 meta-allocation overlay이므로 AX-001 v2 (defense factor 조건부 평가) 직접 적용 어려움. Crisis_alpha 8 periods: 1 positive (GFC +61bps), 2 small negative (-49 ~ -171bps), 5 unchanged. MDD complement vs S1 = +5.65pp (S3 -29.91% vs S1 -35.56%). 'meaningful in crisis' 약하게 만족.
ax_compliance_check.AX-002_process_no_circumvent: PASS. Forge harness 산출 SR만 metric_type=backtested 자격. 본 alpha_validation.json의 SR 1.6336 은 self-validation (factor_engine_continuous label, metric_type=estimated) — Forge backtest 대기. 본 단계는 alpha_signal_strength meta only.
ax_compliance_check.AX-005_avoidance: PASS by design. BAB Frazzini-Pedersen 2014 standalone 미사용. Q07+D25 single-sleeve combo 미사용. 본 구조는 STR_1715 sleeve + Cash sleeve 2-sleeve, AX-005 자연스러운 회피.
ax_compliance_check.AX-007_EXCEPTION_1: PASS. 'multi-sleeve via regime overlay' 정합. STR_1715 sleeve (Core_Alpha) + Cash sleeve (regime-conditional). long_only_top20 single_sleeve 회피.
